strongest_angle: Break down the shocking findings from The Penny Hoarder's October 2026 State of Savings survey revealing that only 35% of working Americans have an emergency fund and 44% lack $1,000 in emergency savings.

key_facts.fact: According to The Penny Hoarder's 2026 State of Savings survey published by Katie Sartoris and Tiffany Connors, only 35% of working Americans say they have an emergency fund.
The Penny Hoarder's 2026 State of Savings in America Survey found that 44% of Americans don’t have $1,000 in emergency savings.
Yahoo Finance reported on The Penny Hoarder's 2026 State of Savings in America survey on October 1, 2026, highlighting that only 35% of working Americans have an emergency fund.
